1360.4: Gatha, by the Fifth Guru (Guru Arjan Dev Ji). Ik Oankar: God is One, the all-pervading Creator, realised through the True Guru's grace. Camphor, flowers and perfumes, touching the human body, become soiled; (within it are) marrow, blood and stench; yet, O Nanak, the ignorant one takes pride (in it). ॥1॥
Gatha is the name of an old Prakrit idiom in which Sanskrit, Pali and other tongues mingle; these verses are in it. Within the verses, gatha means a song of praise.
1360.5: (Though one became) as fine as an atom (and went) to the farthest bound of the skies, over continents, worlds and mountains, reaching them in the twinkling of an eye: without the Saadh (the holy Guru), O Nanak, one does not succeed. ॥2॥
1360.6: Know that death is certain; all that is seen is passing; says Nanak: only the praise (of God), (sung) through the company of the Saadh, goes along (with one). ॥3॥
1360.7: Maya makes the mind wander among dear ones, friends and kin; O Nanak, the abode of peace, the worship of Gopal (the Lord who sustains all), is found through the company of the Saadh. ॥4॥
1360.8: In the company of the sandal of Mount Malaya, the nim tree becomes sandal; but the bamboo growing close by, O Nanak, does not become fragrant, for its proud mind. ॥5॥
1360.9: Weaving songs of praise to Gopal and telling (his) story, pride is crushed and ground down; O Nanak, by loosing the arrow of the Lord (his praise), the five enemies (lust, anger, greed, attachment and pride) are slain. ॥6॥
1360.10: The Saadh's words are the road to peace; they are found by great good fortune; birth and death come to an end, O Nanak, by dwelling on the praise of the Lord. ॥7॥
1360.11: Leaves wither and fall, and are not joined again to the branches of the tree; without the Name there is hardship; O Nanak, (those without it) drift through births day and night. ॥8॥
1360.12: Faith (in the Name) is found through the company of the Saadh, by great good fortune; dwelling on the Lord's Name and virtues, O Nanak, (one) is not overwhelmed by the ocean of the world. ॥9॥
1360.13: The praise of the Boundless One is deep; rare is the one who understands it; worldly desires are given up, O Nanak, by dwelling on Gobind (the Lord of the universe) in the company of the Saadh. ॥10॥
1360.14: The words of the Saadh are the sublime mantra that destroys millions of sins; meditation on the Lord's lotus feet, O Nanak, saves all the generations of one's family. ॥11॥
1360.15: Beautiful is it to dwell in that house within which the Lord's praise (is sung); those who dwell on Gobind are free; O Nanak, (this) is found by great good fortune. ॥12॥
1360.16: The Lord is found, the truest of friends, who never breaks the heart, whose dwelling is of a weight beyond measure; him has Nanak made the companion of his soul. ॥13॥
1360.17: As a worthy son wipes away (his family's) ill fame, (so) the Guru's teaching should be remembered in the heart; the beloved Lord, the Unshakeable One, O Nanak, carries (one) across the ocean of the world. ॥14॥
1361.1: To forget Gobind is death; to meditate on the Lord's Name is life; it is found in the company of the Saadh, O Nanak, as the Lord has written from the beginning. ॥15॥
1361.2: As the snake-charmer (garudi) by his mantra leaves the serpent without fangs and takes away (its venom), (so) the Sants root out disease; O Nanak, (the Sants) are met through good fortune. ॥16॥
1361.3: The One who pervades all places, the refuge of all beings: with him, O Nanak, love is formed by the grace of the Guru's sight. ॥17॥
1361.4: The mind pierced by the lotus feet (of God) attains every happiness; O Nanak, they sing (his) song of praise whose destiny is written from long ago. ॥18॥
1361.5: By uttering the blessed words (of God's praise) and going to the company of the Saadh, one is saved; O Nanak, one is not born again and again in the ocean of the world. ॥19॥
1361.6: One who, reflecting on the Vedas, the Puranas and the Shastras, enshrines in the heart the Name of Ekankar (the One Creator) saves all the generations of his family; O Nanak, it is some rare fortunate one who (thus) carries (them) across. ॥20॥
1361.7: By remembering the Name of Gobind, all the generations of one's family are saved; (the Name) is found through the company of the Saadh; O Nanak, the fortunate are granted the sight (of the Saadh). ॥21॥
1361.8: Giving up all faults entirely, holding firm to all dharma: (this) is found in the company of the Saadh, O Nanak, (by one on whose) forehead (it) is written. ॥22॥
1361.9: He who was, is and will be, the destroyer and the sustainer, who fills all: know for certain, O Nanak, that the Saadh is the means of love (for him). ॥23॥
1361.10: Pleasant, jewel-like words, and absorption in the colours of the safflower (whose bright dye soon fades): (in these are) disease, sorrow and separation; O Nanak, there is no peace (in them), not even in a dream. ॥24॥
